prose: Patrick Daly of the P.A.T. Life podcast returns to discuss his new self-health venture, The New Biology Clinic. As a seasoned personal trainer and holistic mystic, Pat has learned to incorporate the wisdom of nature's sacred geometry and harmonic signatures into a powerful system of functional movement for helping the body not only heal, but become incredibly strong and resilient. Joining our panel is the eternal athlete and author, Al Dawg, along with Slick Dissident.
